disclaimer: Academic estimated comparison bands for Mumbai cab platforms. These are NOT official or live prices: no scraping and no paid API is used. Edit the numbers below to tune the simulation.

ola_mini.name: Ola Mini / Go
ola_mini.description: Popular hatchback cab service for quick daily commutes across Mumbai.

uber_go.name: Uber Go
uber_go.description: Standard air-conditioned hatchback and compact sedan rides.

rapido_bike_cab.name: Rapido Bike / Auto
rapido_bike_cab.description: Affordable first-mile / last-mile bike taxi and auto rickshaw option.

mumbai_kaali_peeli.name: Mumbai Kaali-Peeli Taxi
mumbai_kaali_peeli.description: Meter-regulated black and yellow taxi (no surge or rain pricing). VERIFY the tariff and the night-surcharge window against the current transport-authority notification before quoting it.

vehicle_note: vehicle_multipliers scale each platform's fare for the selected vehicle category (1.0 = the platform's base rates). null means the platform does not offer that category. These are academic assumptions - edit them to tune the simulation.
